options.distractor: already 是完成时的标志词
这里强调“已经完成”，对现在有影响

questions.explanation: already 标志现在完成时，用 have finished。

questions.stem: — ____ you ____ (see) the new film? — Not yet.

options.distractor: 问的是到目前为止有没有看过
答语 Not yet 提示用完成时

questions.explanation: 答语 Not yet 对应现在完成时：Have you seen…?

questions.stem: She ____ (live) in this city for ten years.

options.distractor: for ten years 表示持续到现在
lived 表示过去住过、现在不住了
for ten years 不与进行时连用表示长期状态

questions.explanation: 从十年前持续到现在，用 has lived。

questions.stem: We ____ (not hear) from him so far.

options.distractor: so far（到目前为止）是完成时的标志
so far 表示到现在为止

questions.explanation: so far 搭配现在完成时，用 haven't heard。

options.text: I have already finished my lunch.
He has just come back from school.
I have finished my homework yesterday.

questions.explanation: yesterday 是具体过去时间点，应改为 I finished my homework yesterday。

questions.stem: — Would you like something to eat? — No, thanks. I ____ lunch already.

options.distractor: 缺少过去分词，句子不完整

questions.explanation: “已经吃过午饭了”用 have had（have 的过去分词是 had）。
